printer: Bambu Lab A1 mini or dimensionally equivalent FDM
material: PETG, dried per filament supplier instructions, lot recorded
lower_orientation: side face on build plate; CAD X/lanyard-hole axis is rotated onto printer build Z
upper_orientation: broad exterior face on build plate; CAD Z is aligned to printer build Z
support: enabled for lower case overhangs with removable interface; keep support out of connector mating throat and finish hole without reducing 3.2 mm diameter
adhesive: if required for EVT, use PETG-compatible adhesive only at the case seam; no adhesive on battery, harness, connector or lanyard primary load path
inspection: record actual slicer version and exported 3MF hash
confirm sliced lower orientation X and upper orientation Z before printing
confirm lanyard ligament is rendered solid by perimeters
measure hole diameter, USB bay, seam, overall dimensions and mass
reject voids, under-extrusion, layer separation, support damage or connector-throat residue
release_limit: Profile selection is not strength evidence; Gate F proof, fatigue, wear, sweat and drop tests remain mandatory.
